title: Star-Studded Encino Mansion Relist: Meghan Trainor seeks $17.995 million; Zedd, Joe Jonas among past owners
summary_full: Meghan Trainor and Daryl Sabara have put their Encino mansion on the market for a staggering $17.995 million. Acquired just two years ago from Zedd for $17.125 million, this luxurious property has a rich celebrity lineage, previously owned by Joe Jonas and Sophie Turner. Boasting opulent features such as a recording studio and a private gym, it's yet to be determined if they'll achieve their asking price.
